description: This Java class 'AIMPaymentServices' provides integration with Authorize.Net payment gateway, including methods for authorization, capture, refund, release, and transaction processing, with detailed configuration and response handling.

classes.name: AIMPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides methods for processing payments via Authorize.Net including authorization, capture, refund, release, and transaction validation.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction with the payment gateway.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a transaction, with logic to void if refund fails.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) an authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Unsupported credit method, returns error.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization and capture in one step.

methods.name: processCard
methods.description: Handles sending the payment request to Authorize.Net and processes the response.

methods.name: buildAIMProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for the payment gateway.

methods.name: buildMerchantInfo
methods.description: Adds merchant credentials to the request.

methods.name: buildGatewayResponeConfig
methods.description: Configures response format settings.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Adds billing info to the request.

methods.name: buildEmailSettings
methods.description: Adds email notification settings.

methods.name: buildInvoiceInfo
methods.description: Adds invoice and description info.

methods.name: buildAuthTransaction
methods.description: Prepares authorization transaction data.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Prepares capture transaction data.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Prepares refund transaction data.

methods.name: buildVoidTransaction
methods.description: Prepares void transaction data.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the request before sending.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of an authorization.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a capture.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a refund.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response of a release.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes combined auth and capture response.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway.

methods.name: getCardType
methods.description: Maps internal card type to Authorize.Net code.

methods.name: getXAmount
methods.description: Extracts amount from request map.

methods.name: isVoidableResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response code indicates a voidable transaction.

methods.name: isTestMode
methods.description: Determines if the gateway is in test mode.
